market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham under Graham Potter have enough quality to stay up comfortably. The current 34.5% implied probability reflects the poor 2024-25 campaign, but historically teams with this squad and financial power face a 10-20% relegation risk per season. The market appears to overestimate the danger.
evidence_points: West Ham finished 16th in 2024-25 but were only briefly in the relegation zone under Potter, who steadied the ship.
The squad contains internationals like Bowen, Kudus, and Paqueta, and significant investment is expected in summer 2025.
Teams of West Ham's stature (recent top-9 finishes, Europa Conference League winners 2023) rarely get relegated in a single bad season.
sources_consulted: 2024-25 Premier League table and West Ham form under Graham Potter
Historical Premier League relegation probabilities by pre-season betting odds (e.g., oddschecker typical ranges for mid-table clubs)
Squad valuation and transfer market expectations for 2025-26
